toward/step: Now step, here with eta one half. Row zero belongs to the correct class, and its ds is minus zero point seven, so it gains zero point three five times x: it moves toward x.
toward/away: Row one, the wrong class, has ds plus zero point seven. It loses zero point three five times x, and moves away.
